meta.label: Dataiku Plugins dataset
meta.description: a dataset describing the plugins installed on this DSS instance

params.name: compute_disk_util
params.label: Compute disk space utilization
params.description: Enable checking disk space used by each plugin. Checking this box populates the column named 'plugin_disk_space_size_MB'. WARNING: This adds an additional 30+ seconds per plugin, so checking a DSS Node with 280 installed plugins adds nearly 2.5 hours to run.

params.name: compute_plugin_usages
params.label: Include list of project keys that use each plugin
params.description: Enable computing which projects are used by each plugin. Checking this box populates the column named 'plugin_used_in_projectkeys'. WARNING: This adds an additional 30+ seconds per plugin, so checking a DSS Node with 280 installed plugins and 2,700 projects adds nearly 2.5 hours to run.
